In addition to pop, unlike American universities, Indian universities are gated, bubbles with little to no connection to the local community. With gated campuses it’s physically and mentally distinct from the town in which it is located. Which is why you had people studying nanotechnology in IITK while the neighboring villages didnt even have running water until recently.
In the United States, the university is intimately related to the surrounding city and town. So creates an ecosystem, creating jobs, connections
